[EN] Mission Orders

The Black Claw stationed at the Arena of Defiance and in Feral Valley have been attacking anyone who goes by that area.

Hunt {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#Black Claw slaughterers} and {@LinkCreature:41#3006#Black Claw blood fighters}.

Report to Coordinator Glasrinne when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Las Black Claw apostadas en la Arena of Defiance y en Feral Valley han estado atacando a cualquiera que pase por esa zona.

Caza {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#Black Claw slaughterers} y {@LinkCreature:41#3006#Black Claw blood fighters}.

Preséntate ante el Coordinador Glasrinne cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
